Saratov House – PG in Rajarajeshwari Nagar, Bengaluru
Saratov House is a thoughtfully designed PG in Rajarajeshwari Nagar, Bengaluru, offering a secure and comfortable living environment for students and working professionals. The property is situated in a well-connected and peaceful locality, making daily commutes convenient.

Located in Rajarajeshwari Nagar, Bengaluru, residents benefit from proximity to educational institutions, corporate offices, hospitals, supermarkets, restaurants, and reliable public transport facilities.

The PG features fully furnished rooms equipped with comfortable beds, wardrobes, study tables, and ample storage space. Amenities include high-speed Wi-Fi, freshly prepared daily meals, housekeeping services, laundry support, and well-maintained common areas for relaxation and community interaction.

With CCTV surveillance, secure entry systems, and attentive on-site staff, Saratov House ensures a safe, organised, and hassle-free stay experience for all residents.
